description: This file defines the 'AuthenticateResponse' class, which represents the response data structure for an authentication request in the public API of the eShopOnWeb project. It contains properties indicating the result of authentication, token, username, lockout status, allowance status, and two-factor requirement.

classes.name: AuthenticateResponse
classes.description: A response class for authentication requests containing result status, token, username, and other authentication-related flags.

methods.name: AuthenticateResponse(Guid correlationId)
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a correlation ID, passing it to the base class.
